# Akshay Saini

> Akshay Saini is a product designer and design engineer (a full stack designer) based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. AI-native product designer who ships: 0-to-1 products, from research to production code.

Product designer with 6+ years designing web and mobile products end to end: research, interaction design, design systems, and detailed UX specs. Has worked with YC-backed teams in fintech, developer tools, no-code, and conversational AI, built six design systems, and partners closely with product, engineering, and content teams. Works in a lean UX loop: an AI-native workflow (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) gets ideas prototyped in real code fast, then validated with users and analytics.

Open to: full-time, contract, and freelance product design or design engineering roles, remote or in Bengaluru.

## Experience

- Product Designer / Design Engineer, Freelancing, Jul 2026 – Present, Bengaluru, India: Designing and shipping AI-native products end to end, from research and Figma to production, for clients and personal launches.
- Design Engineer, 100x.bot (https://100x.bot/), Dec 2025 – Jun 2026, Bengaluru, India · Unlogged Inc, YC S22: Designed and built agentic and conversational AI product experiences for a YC-backed browser automation platform: chat agent, extension UI, marketing site, and design system. (Product 3 of 3 with founder Shardul Lavekar.)
- Lead Product Designer, Kodo (https://www.kodo.com/), Feb 2024 – Nov 2025, Pune, India · YC W21: Led design for a YC W21 enterprise fintech across the Kodo ERP procure-to-pay platform and the corporate card product, turning complex finance and compliance requirements into clear workflows.
- Founding Designer, Unlogged (https://www.producthunt.com/products/unlogged), Dec 2021 – Jan 2024, Remote · YC S22: Joined Videobug, a time-travel debugger for Java, before its YC S22 batch and stayed through the pivot and rebrand to Unlogged, a tool for recording, replaying, and testing Java code. (Product 2 of 3 with founder Shardul Lavekar.)
- Founding Designer, Tulr (https://www.producthunt.com/products/tulr-io), Feb 2021 – Dec 2021, Gurgaon, India · AuthMe Id Services: Designed Tulr, a no-code “Lego kit” of tables, screen recordings, forms, and calendars with automation, replacing Airtable, Typeform, Calendly, and Loom for internal apps like applicant tracking. (Product 1 of 3 with founder Shardul Lavekar.)
- Product & Graphic Designer, Freelance, May 2020 – Jan 2021, Gurgaon, India: Contract product and graphic design for early-stage startups across web, apps, packaging, and brand assets.
- Graphic Designer (Intern), tenxresults, Aug 2019 – Nov 2019, Gurgaon, India: Brand and marketing design for a results-driven marketing agency.
- Graphic Designer & Co-founder, Wallzy (https://chrome-stats.com/d/com.phpmalik.wallzyPro), Jan 2017 – Dec 2018, Hisar, Haryana: Designed and built an Android wallpaper app with custom editing tools.

## Projects and case studies

- [Cue](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/cue-dj-studio): Public beta · A free DJ studio in the browser, with an Automix that explains every transition and a coach that teaches you to mix.
- [Ion Workspace](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/ion-workspace): Ongoing · A connected business workspace for email, calendars, contacts, and files, with a public sample-data demo.
- [Indus Best Mega Food Park](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/indus-best-mega-food-park): Live in production · Freelance redesign and custom build for a food-processing campus — clearer facilities, investor journeys, and enquiries.
- [Postforge](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/postforge): On-brand social posts and slide decks — upload a logo, shuffle layouts, brief AI in chat, and export from one canvas.
- [RupeeLens](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/rupeelens): Personal finance from Indian bank statements — local-first import, AI categorization, and spending insights in ₹.
- [100x.Bot Marketing Site](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/100x-landing-page): YC-backed marketing site for browser automation — designed and built with Cursor.
- [Design with AI](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/100x-chat-shell): A personal AI workspace — streaming chat, memory, RAG, and a conversational design studio in one shell.
- [Resume Builder](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/resume-builder): AI resume builder — public profile import and a private owner workspace sharing one PDF pipeline.
- [100x Agent Extension](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/v1-100x-proto): V1 agent extension prototype — chat, workflows, data explorer, and app generation in one shell.
- [Kodo — Procure-to-Pay ERP](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/kodo): Led design for Kodo's procure-to-pay ERP v1, live with redBus and Brndme: workflow builder, permissions, mailbox and Zoho/Tally sync, two design systems with 1,000+ components, NPCI screens and the website.
- [Videobug → Unlogged — Java DevTools](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/unlogged): Founding designer from pre-YC to pivot: Videobug, a time-travel debugger for Java (YC S22), became Unlogged, an open-source IntelliJ plugin for record, replay, mocks and JUnit tests.
- [Tulr — No-Code Platform](https://www.akshaysaini.xyz/projects/tulr): Pre-LLM-era no-code platform combining videos, tables, forms, and calendars with automation — designed as a one-shot replacement for Airtable, Typeform, Calendly, and Loom.
